name: Route Universe / Application Workbench
purpose: Create the national route universe and application workbench foundation for universities, TVET, SETA/learnerships, bursaries, accommodation, employers, NSFAS, CAO, private colleges, MAP fallback, portal health, fees, deadlines, and readiness.
route_laws: All national sectors remain available from day one.
Packages control campaign weight, route count, monitoring, and priority, not dignity or sector access.
Source confidence is required for route-facing links, deadlines, fees, and instructions.
Official sources receive Band A only when sourced from official government, institution, authority, or portal pages.
CAO is one Kingsmen application with internal choices as child items.
CAO fees and limits must be treated as portal rules, not Kingsmen guarantees.
NSFAS support is route support and document support, not a no-fee bypass or approval guarantee.
CAPTCHA, OTP, downtime, or manual-only portals must route to MAP fallback.
Private colleges must require CHE/DHET/SAQA/QCTO verification before being treated as safe.
No fake deadlines, fake links, fake requirements, fake programme availability, or fake acceptance claims.
Route universe data can be incomplete but must never be falsely presented as complete.
